Name: Jacob's Fancy Mayo
Author: DuchessIvy
Description:
'Tis I, DuchessIvy, aka Duchess of Slaads, and I have done what I promised.

A mod inspired by Spencer and Jacob's Stardew Valley playthrough on Arcane Arcade. Just a silly little mod that adds 5 mayo recipes.

The recipes:
[list]
[*]Garlic Aioli [spoiler]Garlic x2, Large White Egg, Large Brown Egg, Oil[/spoiler]
[*]Void Aioli [spoiler]Void Egg, Hot Pepper x2, Oil[/spoiler]
[*]Duck Aioli [spoiler]Duck Egg x3 Spring Onion x2, Truffle Oil[/spoiler]
[*]Dino Aioli [spoiler]Dinosaur egg, Leek x2, Honey, Oil[/spoiler]
[/list]
And one final recipe which can only be gained by having 8 hearts with Sebastian which combines the buffs of all four other aiolis.

If you choose to download and play with this mod, please let me know if you run into issues so I can fix them.

Gift tastes have been added for Krobus, Marnie, Gus, Penny, Abigail, and Sebastian.

Downloads.Description: Only proceed if you are a silly goose who wants to build a mayo empire.
